It fires arrows straight and true, as if beams of light.|Inventory|BotW}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 100 |durability = 100 |flammable = |magnetic = no |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |distance = 8000 |multiplier = |zoom = |reflect = |bash = }} The Twilight Bow is a rare [[Bow]] that was once used by [[Princess Zelda]] in {{TP}}. It can be rarely acquired from a [[Treasure Chest]] that spawns after scanning the {{SSB|-}} series Princess Zelda [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], though only after completing at least one of the [[Divine Beast]]s. It is said to contain the power of the [[Spirit of Light|Spirits of Light]]. Like the Bow of Light from {{TP|-}}, it fires [[Light Arrow]]s. The Twilight Bow shares many characteristics with the Bow of Light; they both fire Light Arrows resembling those seen in {{TP|-}}, and both have the greatest range of any Bow.
